thread:
maria: Quick sync — HW partner just confirmed GPU-credit allocation and wants the marketplace listing to go live same day as our blog/press. Need to lock timing + who owns CTA mapping + legal on promo terms. :rocket:

devin: timeline check — is partner targeting a hard date from their side? we need 72h for canary and 24h for final smoke tests.

maria: they proposed Tue 2026-06-09 10:00 PT. That gives us 9 days. Can we do it?

sam: marketing: we can aim for that date if creative + press quotes are ready by Fri. blog draft in progress — will share link. need partner quote by Thu EOD.

kevin: PR: embargo window? partner expects coordinated announcement. propose embargo until publish time, but need legal signoff on joint statement. who will draft?

alisha: design: I'll finalize hero and partner badge. need exact partner logo+brand colors and the CTA copy (trial vs credits). can we use "Try with partner credits"?

maria: CTA should map to marketplace SKU with promo token so credits apply automatically. vikram — can you confirm we can accept a promo token param on the listing redirect?

vikram: yes — marketplace flow can accept a ?promo_token= param that applies a credit record. engineering needs the token format and TTL. recommend 48h TTL. also: SI integrations need a small webhook to confirm activation.

maria: noted. tony, legal — are there any compliance hoops for partner credits + TTL? any consumer-facing T&Cs we must show?

tony: legal: simple promo terms ok. must include: expiry date, one-per-customer, non-transferable. partner wants longer window (30d) but we suggest 14d to limit abuse. will prepare short T&C blurb for landing and marketplace.

sam: marketing: 14d is fine. We'll include example copy and short FAQ. partner PM asked for UTM tracking — use utm_source=partner&utm_campaign=marketplace_launch.

maria: partner also asked about co-marketing assets: blog co-auth, press quote, landing takeover 24h. we should sequence: (1) marketplace listing publish, (2) blog goes live, (3) press embargo lifts. any objections?

kevin: prefer embargo lift synchronized at publish. if listing must go first for signup flow, that's okay but press embargo time must be identical. we'll set embargo to publish time.

alisha: design question — do we do a landing takeover or inline banner? takeover requires frontend slot and scheduling.

vikram: front-end can do a scheduled takeover; ops needs the deploy window. we can toggle via feature flag. recommend feature-flag roll at T-2h, enable at T.

maria: deploy-bot — please queue the feature-flag toggle for release window.

deploy-bot: sched: feature-flag "partner_takeover_20260609" queued for 2026-06-09T09:58:00-07:00. Will auto-enable at 2026-06-09T10:00:00-07:00.

sam: checklist from marketing: blog draft (sam) — share by Thu; partner quote (partner) — Thu EOD; press release (kevin) — Fri AM; social assets (alisha/sam) — Fri PM; press embargo docs (kevin/tony) — Fri EOD.

vikram: engineering checklist: marketplace SKU published to staging (vikram) — Mon; promo token integration tested (vikram) — Tue T-1; webhook handshake with partner (vikram) — Tue T-1; feature-flag scheduled (ops) — Tue T-2h.

maria: action owners: maria (orchestration), devin (launch ops), sam (marketing creative), kevin (press), alisha (design), tony (legal), vikram (eng). I'll run a dry-run next Mon at 10:00 PT.

devin: I'll put a calendar invite for dry-run + include partner reps.

kevin: one more: partner asked if we can provide an embargoed headshot and short quote from our CEO for co-announcement. maria, can you get that to me by Thu?

maria: yes — I'll request.

alisha: note — need partner-approved logo SVG before Fri to avoid last-minute brand delays.

vikram: small technical note — marketplace listing needs to validate promo_token signature. will share example HMAC scheme: `HMAC_SHA256(base64(token), secret)` in #eng-runtime for review.

tony: legal will draft T&Cs and a one-paragraph joint statement guideline for the PR team.

maria: thanks all. summary of immediate asks posted to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketplace/hw-partner-launch with checklist. next check: Mon 2026-05-31 10:00 PT (dry-run planning). :eyes: 

deploy-bot: note: marketplace staging publish completed for sku "redwood-gpu-starter" at 2026-05-26T14:03:12Z — last verified by vikram.
